extraction.issue_description: The customer reports that a purchase of $249.99 at an online electronics retailer on 28 August 2026 was charged twice to her credit card. She only placed one order and the merchant confirmed a single order number. She is unhappy that the duplicate charge is increasing her balance before the statement date.
extraction.resolution_provided: Agent verified the duplicate authorisation with the merchant acquirer. The duplicate charge of $249.99 has been reversed and the refund has been posted to the card account on 03 September 2026. Customer confirmed she is satisfied.
